name: Toyoshina (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Toyoshina town emblem in white: a stylised device of curved strokes like a letter X with a small triangle.
history: Flag of the former town of Toyoshina in Nagano Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Toyoshina town emblem — a stylised device of curved strokes like a letter X with a small triangle
